sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of 'Space Pumpkin' are straightforward and easy to understand. Your goal is to navigate your pumpkin spaceship through the asteroid field, avoiding collisions and collecting points. As you navigate through the asteroid field, you'll encounter various obstacles, including asteroids, alien spaceships, and power-ups. The power-ups, on the other hand, are a welcome addition, providing bonuses and boosts to help you progress through the game.

The game's score system is based on points, which are awarded for collecting power-ups, avoiding collisions, and completing levels. The game also features a high-score system, which allows players to compete with each other and strive for the top spot.
